shared_elements: rows of repeated vertical/comb-like strokes forming a band
horizontal register bands dividing the surface
justification: Both surfaces are covered with schematic figural motifs arranged in stacked horizontal registers, and both include a band of repeated short vertical strokes (a comb-like row) plus small quadruped and anthropomorph figures. But the specific content differs entirely: A shows large relief animals in profile (a bird-like creature, a quadruped, a long-necked bird) with body-part motifs and a fringed pendant device, while B is dominated by large keel-and-crew boat forms with rows of crew strokes and tiny stick figures, a motif absent from A; the rendering also differs (raised modelled relief silhouettes versus thin uniform outline drawing).
